company_name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE ADS, 1 ADS = 8 ordinary shares)

inputs.sbc_source: FY0 = FY2026 20-F (BABA_Annual_FY2026.txt:5799): share-based compensation expense RMB14,821M (FY2025 15,577; FY2024 18,546), the company's combined figure including cash-settled awards; no separate equity-award tax line is disclosed. Q1 FY2027 (BABA_Quarterly_Q1-FY2027.txt:508): total SBC RMB3,304M incl. cash-settled (non-cash 2,962), -7% YoY, 1.23% of quarterly revenue -- the combined figure is the one charged, consistent with the annual basis.
inputs.interest_income_source: FY2026 20-F note 2(ah) (BABA_Annual_FY2026.txt:9537): interest income RMB18,806M (FY2025 20,449; FY2024 24,868), recorded inside 'interest and investment income, net' (Q1 FY2027 that net line was 9,004, release line 924, interest component not separately disclosed). Stripped because net cash is many multiples of the FCF base.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 repurchases RMB7,638M (vs 86,662 FY2025); Q1 FY2027 13.4M shares for US$162M (release line 201), down ~80% YoY. Buybacks are value-neutral in this model (SBC expensed, count held flat ex the placing); the company is no longer funding the flat count in cash -- it issued 710M shares on 2026-08-26 instead -- which is why SBC is charged in full and the placing shares are added explicitly.
inputs.share_count_basis: 2,504.25M ADS-equivalent = 20,034M ordinary shares / 8. The 20,034M = 19,324M weighted-average diluted ordinary shares for the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026 (non-GAAP diluted EPS table, BABA_Quarterly_Q1-FY2027.txt:1111; FY2026 basis was 19,235M) PLUS 710M new ordinary shares issued in the 26 Aug 2026 Hong Kong placing (6-K accession 0001193125-26-365894). Identical to the 9988.HK build of the same date (20,034M ordinary). Held FLAT thereafter: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so no further dilution is compounded; the placing is genuine non-SBC issuance and is the only count change. CSV Q1/Q2 FY2026 SharesOutstanding cells (140,072 / 132,578) are mis-mapped segment revenue and were ignored.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (ISO CNY); quote in USD per ADS. fx_rate 0.149817 = 1 / USDCNY 6.6748 (Yahoo USDCNY=X, 2026-10-22T01:46Z); CNY-suffixed twins are therefore RMB per ADS, and RMB per ORDINARY share = twin / 8. Cross-rates at the same timestamp: USDHKD 7.8455, CNYHKD 1.1748 (= 7.8455/6.6748 = 1.1754), the rate the sibling 9988.HK build used (1.175). Parity: BABA ADS NYSE close 2026-10-21 x USDHKD / 8 = HK$102.39 against the 9988.HK close of HK$103.70 the same day (ADS 1.3% below) and the HK$100.60 HKEX morning print on 2026-10-22 (ADS 1.8% above; the HK line sold off ~3% intraday after the US close) -- rate, direction and ADS ratio tie, and the two listings are within normal Southbound/US-session drift of each other. RMB-level parity with 9988.HK_DCF.json: its weighted_iv_cny 77.87/ordinary share x 8 / 6.6748 = US$93.33 per ADS, which this build must reproduce within rounding; any residual is the quote conversion only. The placing proceeds (HK$79,785M net) are converted at the same CNYHKD 1.175 as the HK build = RMB67,902M so the two balance sheets are identical.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-21T20:03:43Z NYSE regular close (the 22 Oct US session had not opened at build time; not an after-hours print)
inputs.balance_sheet_note: Q1 FY2027 balance sheet (30 Jun 2026, BABA_Quarterly_Q1-FY2027.txt:962-998) is now the latest filing. Net cash on the house convention = unrestricted cash 142,914 + short-term investments 154,653 + other treasury investments 176,938 = 474,505 (release line 707, the company's own 'cash and other liquid investments, unrestricted' figure; same unrestricted basis as the FY2026 520,824) less total debt 266,530 (current bank borrowings 30,614 + non-current bank borrowings 56,007 + senior notes 115,716 + convertible notes 54,905 + exchangeable bonds 9,288; FY2026 259,996). That is net cash 207,975, down 52,853 in the quarter: FCF -44,670, FX translation -5,853 (USD weakened vs RMB), debt +6,534. Identical to the 9988.HK build of 2026-10-22 (same filings; the BABA Extracted texts are byte-identical copies, same line numbers). inputs.cash (542,407) and net_debt (-275,877) are PRO FORMA for the 26 Aug 2026 placing: 474,505 + RMB67,902M net proceeds. Two post-balance-sheet/timing items sit in equity_bridge rather than in net_debt so the balance sheet stays traceable: (i) +44,670 Q1 FY2027 reported FCF added back, because the FY2027 year-1 projected flow already contains that quarter's burn and the 30 Jun cash has already absorbed it -- without the add-back the quarter is charged twice; (ii) -16,700 FY2026 regular dividend (US$0.13125/share, ~US$2.5bn, 20-F line 7530) declared May 2026, charged to retained earnings in the quarter (RE fell 6,467 against 10,537 of attributable income) and paid in July 2026, i.e. a liability at 30 Jun that today's holder does not receive. Q2 FY2027 (Jul-Sep 2026) burn is in neither the balance sheet nor an add-back; it sits inside the projected FY2027 flow, which is where it belongs.
inputs.placing_treatment: Equity placing completed 2026-08-26: 710,000,000 new ordinary shares at HK$112.70, gross ~HK$80.0bn, stated net proceeds HK$47,871M + HK$31,914M = HK$79,785M, use of proceeds AI compute / data centres (6-K filed 2026-08-26, accession 0001193125-26-365894). Placed with non-US persons under Regulation S, so ADS holders could not participate; that is a dilution already captured in the count, not an additional ADS-level charge. Treatment: the 710M shares are ADDED to the share count (19,324 -> 20,034M ordinary = 2,415.5 -> 2,504.25M ADS) and the net proceeds are ADDED to cash (RMB67,902M at CNYHKD 1.175) in inputs.cash / net_debt. The capex the proceeds fund is ALREADY in the projection (FY2027 capex 23% of revenue, RMB ~257bn; FY2028 21%), so the proceeds are NOT also netted against projected capex -- counting the cash and reducing the capex would double-count. The placing is slightly accretive to IV per share (issued at HK$112.70 = ~US$114.9/ADS, above the model's weighted IV) and is shown as its own reconciliation line. It is also evidence: raising ~RMB68bn of equity at a 52-week-low-area price, with RMB208bn of net cash still on hand, says management expects the compute spend to run beyond internal cash generation through FY2028, which is why FY2027-28 capex intensity is nudged up 1pp (see assumptions.base.capex_rationale).
inputs.wacc_rationale: MIRRORED from 9988.HK (same date): built in the flows' own currency (RMB), single rate across scenarios (risk lives in the flows and weights, charged once). Cost of equity 10.6% = China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.1 x China ERP 5.5% (7.85%) + 1.5% VIE/Cayman-structure and PRC platform-regulation premium + 0.5% US geopolitical/DoD 1260H overhang + 0.75% EU DSA and litigation premium. Debt ~13% of capital at ~2.1% after tax gives 9.5%; rounded UP to 10.0%. The ADS listing does not change the rate: the flows are the same RMB flows, and the US-specific overhangs (DoD 1260H, HFCAA/delisting tail risk, the Anthropic-distillation securities investigations) are group-level claims on the same cash flows already carried in the 0.5% US premium; charging them again on the ADS line would price the same risk twice and would also break ADS/HK parity, which the market itself holds within ~1-2%. Would move on: a DSA follow-on penalty actually levied (into the flows, premium out), or a DoD 1260H ruling either way.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases are expensed inside adjusted EBITDA (US GAAP ASC 842 operating-lease cost in opex); lease liabilities are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt. Finance leases are immaterial. One treatment, consistently applied.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; noncontrolling interests (RMB57,272M) and mezzanine equity (RMB7,584M) at 30 Jun 2026 book are deducted once in the equity bridge. Not folded into the tax rate as well.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: marketplace + cloud), 10-year horizon FY2027-FY2036 because the owner-FCF margin is still ramping through FY2031. This is a REBUILD of the BABA line onto the RMB-level model built for 9988.HK on 2026-10-22 (research/9988.HK/Reports/9988.HK_Drivers.json): the prior BABA_DCF.json (2026-07-26) was a 5-year normalised-FCF model (RMB120bn mid-cycle base, scenario WACCs 11.5/13/10.5%, weights 25/50/25, exit-multiple caps) that did not model the negative FY2027-29 owner FCF explicitly; the component model does, so the methodology change is the largest reconciliation line. Every RMB-level input is identical to 9988.HK -- base revenue, driver paths per scenario, 10% RMB WACC, 3.0/3.5/2.0% terminal growth, 15/15/12x caps, weights 30/50/20, net cash on the cash + ST investments + other treasury investments basis, strategic investments at 50% of book, NCI + mezzanine, Q1 FY2027 FCF stub add-back, FY2026 dividend payable, and the Aug 2026 placing (710M shares, RMB67,902M proceeds). The ONLY differences are the quote: per-ADS (x8), USD (/ USDCNY 6.6748) and the NYSE price. ADS-specific discount: none (inputs.ads_specific_adjustments). Driver judgments as at 9988.HK: FY2027 revenue growth 9% (Q1 +9%, cloud +45%, quick commerce +45%, CMR -7% reported / +1% like-for-like); FY2027 EBITDA margin 13.5% (Q1 adjusted EBITDA 39,143 = 14.6%, AI Labs -13.9bn/qtr); FY2027 D&A 5.5%; FY2027-28 capex 23/21 base, 22/19 bull, 24/22 bear (Q1 run-rate 25% of revenue, +75% YoY, equity raise earmarked for compute); SBC 1.3% plateau (Q1 run-rate 1.23%). FY2029+ growth, margins, D&A, capex, tax, WACC, terminal growth, caps and weights carried from the 9988.HK build unchanged; what would move them is in assumptions.*.unchanged_note. Matching-asset rule: interest income and investment income/share of Ant results are outside the flows, so cash-like assets sit in net_debt and the strategic investment portfolio sits in equity_bridge (at 50% of book). Charge-once rules: SBC expensed + flat count (placing added once, explicitly); NCI deducted in the bridge only; leases in opex only; single WACC; Q1 burn in the balance sheet OR in the flows, not both (stub add-back). Terminal value = max(0, min(Gordon, cap x FCF_N)) on FCF. Keep the two lines in lockstep: a driver change on either ticker must be mirrored on the other the same day.
inputs.ads_ratio: 1 NYSE ADS = 8 ordinary shares (20-F FY2026 cover; every earnings release). shares_outstanding is in ADS-equivalents; all RMB flows, debt, cash and bridge items are group totals, so per-ADS value = group equity value / 2,504.25M ADS.
inputs.ads_specific_adjustments: NONE applied, deliberately. Considered and rejected: (1) HFCAA / forced-delisting discount -- the dual-primary HK listing (Aug 2024) makes an ADS holder's exit a conversion into 9988.HK ordinary shares at the depositary (8:1, a fee of up to US$0.05/ADS), not a loss of the asset; the residual US-ownership-restriction risk (1260H) is in the WACC. (2) Depositary fees -- up to US$0.05 per ADS per year under the deposit agreement, PV at 10% < US$0.5/ADS (0.5% of value), below rounding. (3) Regulation S exclusion of ADS holders from the Aug 2026 placing -- already in the share count; no separate charge. (4) Southbound-flow premium/discount -- a 9988.HK demand effect, ignored on both lines. Parity between the two lines is 1-2%, so the market is not pricing an ADS discount either. Evidence that would introduce one: an SEC/PCAOB determination restarting the HFCAA clock, or a US executive order restricting US-person ownership of the ADS (then a scenario-weighted conversion/forced-sale haircut, not a WACC bump).

Their income (share of Ant results, investment gains, interest-and-investment income) is excluded from EBITDA, so the matching assets belong in the bridge. 50% haircut covers realisation tax (10-25%), illiquidity of unlisted stakes, Ant's regulatory overhang and a conglomerate discount. Same as 9988.HK 2026-10-22; its morning build: 224,362 on the 31 Mar 2026 balance sheet.

equity_bridge.note: Release line 1152: free cash flow -RMB44,670M for the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026 (OCF 22,945 less capex 67,660). Added back undiscounted so the quarter is charged exactly once. Only reported FCF is added back: Q1 SBC (3,304) is non-cash and did not reduce the 30 Jun cash, and Q1 interest income is in the cash and outside the flows, so neither is double-counted.

equity_bridge.note: US$0.13125 per ordinary share / US$1.05 per ADS, ~US$2.5bn (BABA_Annual_FY2026.txt:7530) = ~RMB16,700M at USDCNY 6.6743; corroborated by the Q1 retained-earnings movement (-6,467 against +10,537 attributable income, i.e. ~17,004 less ~300 of statutory-reserve and mezzanine accretion). Not paid within the quarter (financing cash flow +9,469 was almost entirely the +11,005 of net bank borrowings), so it is a liability against the 30 Jun cash that today's buyer does not collect.

historical_growth.owner_fcf_note: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income: FY2024 156,210-18,546-24,868; FY2025 73,870-15,577-20,449; FY2026 -46,609-14,821-18,806; Q1 FY2027 -44,670-3,304 (interest income not separately disclosed in the quarter; the net interest-and-investment line was 9,004). CAGR undefined on a negative end-point. Reported FCF FY2020-FY2025 averaged 134,032M; owner-basis the same years would be ~30-40bn lower. SBC is NOT growing faster than cash flow (18.5bn -> 14.8bn -> Q1 run-rate ~13bn); the collapse is capex (27.6bn FY2024 -> 84.3bn FY2025 -> 122.0bn FY2026 -> 67.7bn in Q1 FY2027 alone).
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR (FY2026-FY2036); equity CAGR (2.5%) is not used because RMB ~250bn of buybacks in FY2022-FY2025 and the FY2026 investment trough depress it
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 2.5% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR 7.4% and EPS 3yr CAGR 17.0%; explained by buybacks and the FY2026 trough, not by a different underlying growth rate.

base.growth_rationale: MIRRORED from 9988.HK (2026-10-22), unchanged there. FY2027 +9% is now confirmed against the extracted Q1 FY2027 release (+9% YoY: AI Cloud and Compute 48,437 +45%, China Quick Commerce 53,295 +45%, China E-commerce 110,900 -8% with CMR -7% reported / +1% like-for-like after the contra-revenue subsidy programme, International -1%, Global Wholesale +7%). Cloud and quick commerce together add ~RMB30bn/quarter YoY, i.e. ~12pp of group growth, against ~-4pp from China E-commerce. Decelerates to 4% by FY2036 as cloud growth normalises; 10-yr CAGR 6.9%.
base.margin_rationale: MIRRORED from 9988.HK; unchanged there at 13.5% for FY2027. Q1 FY2027 adjusted EBITDA 39,143 = 14.6% of revenue (release line 223; adjusted EBITA 27,329 = 10.2%). Segment EBITA: E-commerce Group 39,749 (flat YoY despite quick commerce), Cloud 5,628 (+133%, 11.6% margin), AI Labs -13,861, All others -3,343. A quarter-by-quarter build for FY2027 -- Q2 laps the peak-subsidy Q2 FY2026 (group adjusted EBITA 9,073), Q3 carries 11.11, AI Labs losses held at ~-14-15bn/quarter -- brackets 12-14% for the year, so 13.5% stands. Recovers as quick commerce reaches unit-economics breakeven (guided end-FY2027; Q1 showed sequential improvement in AOV and fulfilment cost while holding share) and cloud scales; matures at 22%.
base.capex_rationale: MIRRORED from 9988.HK, where it was RAISED FY2027 22% -> 23% and FY2028 20% -> 21%; FY2029+ unchanged. Q1 FY2027 capex RMB67,660M (release line 1150; 25.2% of quarterly revenue, +75% YoY, a new high) annualises to ~RMB270bn; management attributes part of the step-up to procurement-cycle timing and chip pricing, so the full year is set below the run-rate at ~RMB257bn (23%). The 26 Aug 2026 placing of ~RMB68bn earmarked for AI compute and data centres, done with RMB208bn of net cash on hand, is read as management expecting spend beyond internal generation through FY2028, hence the FY2028 nudge; the RMB380bn three-year plan is already exceeded by FY2027. Intensity then normalises to 9.5% by FY2035 as before -- above the 5-6% pre-AI norm because cloud is a larger share of revenue. D&A lags capex and peaks at 10% of revenue in FY2030-31. Owner FCF turns positive in FY2030.
base.sbc_rationale: MIRRORED from 9988.HK, where it was LOWERED to a 1.3% plateau (prior 1.5/1.5/1.45/1.4/1.4/1.35/1.3/1.3/1.25/1.25). Q1 FY2027 total SBC 3,304 = 1.23% of revenue, -7% YoY, after 18,546 -> 15,577 -> 14,821 in FY2024-26; the prior path started above the FY2026 actual (1.45%) and would have had SBC rising as a share of revenue into FY2029, which three years of decline do not support. Held at 1.3% (above the Q1 run-rate, allowing for the AI-talent grants management flags) and trimmed to 1.25% only from FY2035.
base.tax_rationale: MIRRORED from 9988.HK (2026-10-22), unchanged there. 18% cash rate on EBIT: 15% HNTE rate on the core PRC subsidiaries, 25% standard elsewhere, plus withholding on repatriation; FY2025 income tax 35.4bn on ~165bn pre-tax = 21% including investment-gain taxes. Same in all scenarios.
base.unchanged_note: FY2029-FY2036 growth, margin, D&A and capex paths, the 18% tax rate, 10% WACC, 3% terminal growth and the 15x FCF cap are carried from the 9988.HK build without re-derivation; relative to the prior BABA model (2026-07-26) they are a methodology change, not a re-judgment of that model's inputs, and are bridged as such in reconciliation. Evidence that would move them: cloud growth decelerating below 30% before segment EBITA margin passes 15% (margin path down); a stated FY2028 capex number from management (capex path either way); quick-commerce breakeven slipping past FY2028 (FY2028-29 margin down); a DSA follow-on penalty or DoD ruling (WACC premium into/out of the flows).

bull.rationale: Same absolute RMB capex as base in FY2027-28 (so intensity 22%/19% on the faster revenue line, moved with the base by 1pp) spread over faster revenue -- cloud sustains 40%+ through FY2029 on Apple Intelligence distribution and the $100bn five-year external cloud+AI target -- so intensity falls faster; cloud mix lifts the mature EBITDA margin to 25%. SBC path mirrors base. Everything else unchanged from the 9988.HK morning build of 2026-10-22. The 15x FCF cap binds (Gordon at 10%/3.5% would be 15.9x).

bear.rationale: AI capex ROI disappoints: FY2027-28 spend proceeds as committed and now equity-funded (24%/22% of revenue, moved with the base by 1pp) but is then cut hard because it does not earn its return, so capex reverts to the 8% pre-AI-plus-cloud norm by FY2034 while revenue growth never exceeds 6% and the EBITDA margin recovers only to 17% (quick-commerce breakeven slips; AI Labs losses persist; EU DSA follow-on penalties and compliance cost weigh on international). SBC path mirrors base. Everything else unchanged. Owner FCF stays negative through FY2030. The 12x FCF cap binds marginally (Gordon at 10%/2% would be 12.75x). Terminal PV exceeds EV because the explicit years are net cash-consuming.

scenario_narratives.base: Execution risk, not impairment. Alibaba is spending the FY2026-FY2028 cash flow of the marketplace -- and, since 26 Aug 2026, RMB ~68bn of fresh equity -- on AI compute (capex ~23% of revenue in FY2027, RMB ~257bn) and on the last leg of the quick-commerce subsidy war, so owner FCF is negative in FY2027-FY2029 and only turns in FY2030. The axes that decide the case: (1) whether AI Cloud and Compute Services keeps compounding at 30-45% with EBITA margin rising from ~12% (Q1 FY2027: revenue +45%, EBITA +133%); (2) whether capex intensity actually falls after FY2028 -- the equity raise says the peak is being funded externally, not that it is over; (3) whether Taobao Instant Commerce reaches unit-economics breakeven by end-FY2027 as guided (Q1 showed sequential improvement at stable share) while the SAMR anti-subsidy rules hold; (4) whether AI Labs/Qwen consumer losses (RMB13.9bn in one quarter) are capped rather than open-ended; (5) core CMR stays roughly flat (-7% reported / +1% like-for-like) rather than resuming share loss to PDD and Douyin. The EU DSA fine (EUR550M, booked in Q1 FY2027 G&A) and the DoD 1260H litigation are carried in the discount rate, not the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: Cloud is now a margin story as well as a growth story: 45% growth with EBITA margin doubling, Apple Intelligence embedding Qwen in the China iPhone base, Qwen3-Max-Thinking keeping Alibaba at the frontier, AI-related product revenue (RMB12.4bn in Q1, twelfth straight triple-digit quarter) approaching a $10bn run-rate, and the $100bn five-year external cloud+AI target on track. The same absolute capex is spread over faster revenue, so intensity normalises by FY2030; quick commerce turns profitable in FY2027 and e-commerce CMR re-accelerates on AI-driven merchant tools. Mature EBITDA margin 25%, terminal FCF margin ~12%; the 15x FCF cap binds, so the bull does not rely on a terminal multiple the market has not paid.
scenario_narratives.bear: The capex supercycle does not pay: management keeps spending through FY2028 (RMB ~520bn over two years, part of it the August 2026 equity) into a price-competitive China AI market (DeepSeek, ByteDance, Huawei), cloud growth decelerates below 25%, AI Labs keeps burning, and the capex is cut only after the returns disappoint. Quick-commerce breakeven slips as Meituan re-engages; CMR resumes low-single-digit decline. On the regulatory axis the EU judges AliExpress remediation inadequate and levies follow-on DSA penalties, and the DoD designation survives the Northern District of California challenge, keeping US institutions out. Owner FCF stays negative until FY2031 and the business is worth little more than its balance sheet (pro-forma net cash + investments ~US$27/ADS of the ~US$49 bear value).

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: MIRRORED from 9988.HK: 30/50/20 (the prior BABA model of 2026-07-26 used 25/50/25; the move to 30/50/20 was made on the HK line on the morning of 2026-10-22 and is bridged as its own reconciliation line here). The extracted Q1 release confirms rather than adds to the evidence that moved them: capex +75% YoY, AI Labs losses quadrupled, buybacks cut ~80%, EU DSA fine booked, DoD litigation unresolved. The placing is neutral on weights -- it removes any liquidity angle from the bear (RMB208bn net cash before proceeds, RMB276bn after) but confirms the spend will run beyond internal generation, which is the bear's premise. Base 50%: gradual normalisation from FY2030, supported by the Q1 cloud margin inflection and continued subsidy de-escalation. Bull 20%: needs sustained 40%+ cloud growth, capex intensity falling from FY2029, quick-commerce breakeven on schedule, no further EU penalties and a DoD win, all at once.

valuation_philosophy.summary: FY2026-FY2029 are investment-trough years by choice, not demand decline. This rebuild retires the July 2026 normalised-FCF model (RMB120bn mid-cycle base, 5 years, scenario-specific WACCs) and puts the BABA line on the same explicit capex-supercycle component owner-FCF model as 9988.HK: negative owner FCF through FY2029, recovery from FY2030, a single RMB-built 10% WACC carrying the regulatory/litigation premium, the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet, the 26 Aug 2026 placing (710M shares, RMB ~68bn), the Q1 burn charged once via a stub add-back and the July dividend deducted. Terminal value is Gordon-bound in base (implied ~6x EV/EBITDA, below the FY2022-25 normal-year 8.1x average), so no multiple expansion is assumed; the strategic investment portfolio (Ant etc.) enters the bridge at half book and NCI is deducted. Nothing in the valuation is ADS-specific: the per-ADS USD value is the RMB value per ordinary share x 8 / USDCNY, and the HK and US lines should move together except for the FX leg. The normalised model's weighted US$126 was built on the premise that FY2026 FCF would mean-revert to ~RMB120bn within the forecast window; the Q1 FY2027 print (capex +75%, FCF -RMB45bn in one quarter) and the equity raise say it will not before FY2030, which is why the value falls ~26% on an unchanged business.
key_risks_to_valuation: Capex intensity: every 1pp of FY2027-FY2031 capex/revenue that does not normalise is ~RMB 60-70bn of cumulative owner FCF; the base assumes intensity halves from 23% to 11% by FY2032. The placing shows the company is willing to fund overshoot with equity, which dilutes rather than merely burns.
Cloud deceleration below 30% before margin matures would break the base margin path (22% mature EBITDA).
EU DSA follow-on penalties (up to 6% of global turnover) and a DoD 1260H loss are in the discount rate (1.25pp), not the flows; a realised penalty of that size would be a flow event.
Investment-portfolio bridge (~US$13.6/ADS at 50% of book) depends on Ant Group's realisable value and PRC exit taxes; strike it and the weighted IV falls by that amount.
Further equity issuance: a second placing of similar size at a price below IV would be dilutive; the model assumes the count is flat at 20,034M from here.

USD/CNY: every 1% move in USDCNY moves every USD/ADS value 1%; fx_rate is dated 2026-10-22 and is not refreshed by refresh_price.py. The RMB has strengthened from 7.25 (mid-2026) to 6.67, which flatters the USD value by ~8% versus a year ago on an unchanged RMB valuation.

ADS-structure risk (HFCAA, 1260H, US-person ownership restrictions) is carried at group level in the WACC and not as an ADS-specific haircut; a US ownership restriction would be a forced-conversion/forced-sale event for ADS holders that the HK line would not share.
ADS/HK parity can drift for weeks (Southbound flows on 9988.HK, US-session sentiment on BABA); the two builds share one RMB value and the cheaper line is the one to own.

bridge.item: Methodology change: 5-year normalised-FCF model (RMB120bn mid-cycle base, scenario WACCs 11.5/13/10.5%, EV/EBITDA exit caps 7.0/9.5/4.5x, no investment-portfolio bridge, no NCI deduction) -> 10-year explicit component owner-FCF model (negative owner FCF FY2027-29, recovery FY2030, single RMB 10% WACC, Gordon/FCF-cap terminal, Ant and other investments at 50% of book, NCI + mezzanine deducted), on the same 31 Mar 2026 balance sheet and 19,235M shares
bridge.note: Residual between two models that do not decompose linearly; stated as the plug. Direction: the normalised model credited ~RMB120bn of FCF from year 1 where the component model books -RMB80-100bn/yr through FY2029 (PV ~-RMB40/share at 10%), partly offset by the investment portfolio at 50% of book (+~RMB11.7/share), the NCI deduction (-~RMB3.4/share) and a lower, single 10% WACC against 11.5% base. After this line the model is the 9988.HK morning build in USD/ADS: bear 49.31 / base 99.78 / bull 152.59, weighted 95.20.
